description: The bar chart illustrates the proportion (as a percentage) of incorrectly answered samples in which the popularity ratio of the generated answer (RPop_Ge) is less than that of the ground truth (RPop_GT), across three distinct domains — Movies, Songs, and Basketball — for three large language models: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, ranges from 50% to 90% with tick marks at 5% intervals, while the horizontal axis categorizes the domains. In the Movies category, Llama3 and Qwen2 both show high ratios near 90%, while ChatGPT is lower at approximately 73%. In Songs, Llama3 and Qwen2 again exhibit high values (~84% and ~90%, respectively), with ChatGPT at ~62%. In Basketball, Llama3 is at ~67%, Qwen2 drops significantly to ~58%, and ChatGPT is at ~61%. The chart visually suggests that Qwen2 and Llama3 tend to generate answers with lower popularity than ground truth more frequently than ChatGPT, particularly in Movies and Songs, while in Basketball, all models show lower ratios, with Qwen2 performing notably worse. The bars are grouped by domain, with each model’s bar clearly color-coded and labeled in the legend.
